survey: docs/12 P1 - Open Images form-factor survey
observer: one observer, single pass, not blind, no adjudication record
this_is: a VISUAL SURVEY. These are counts of what was visibly present in a sample. They are NOT labels, nothing was written back to any manifest, and no crop acquired a form_factor

protocol_deviation.what: the frozen category list has no bucket for 'clearly a waste container, but no taxonomy form factor fits'
protocol_deviation.mostly: front-load dumpsters, roll-off skips and builder's containers
protocol_deviation.how_recorded: counted under `no_matching_form_factor`, broken out rather than folded into `uncertain`, because 'I cannot tell what this is' and 'I can tell, and the taxonomy has no id for it' are different facts and only one of them is a taxonomy finding

crop_size.note: measured, not estimated - from index.json. Open Images frames are already resized to 448 px, so a small box in a wide street scene yields a very small crop
crop_size.why_64: identifier.yaml crops.min_box_px is 64 - the pipeline's own floor
